replacements.p1-r0: SME Technology Development (R&D) Support Project Research and Development Plan
replacements.p1-r2: Development of an RAG-based Business-Specific Real-Time Multilingual Translation AI Solution Aimed at Revolutionizing SME Export Sales through a Global Sales, Consultation, Interpretation, and Document Automation Integrated Platform
replacements.p1-r4: Implement a business-specific AI model. Develop an RAG-based multilingual translation model and a real-time streaming speech interpretation model (within seconds delay, supporting more than 8 languages) that learns company-specific knowledge such as product names, technical specifications, and prices. Develop agents for export process automation throughout the entire lifecycle, including automatically generating export documents like quotations and product pages. Establish a platform integrating unique regulatory certification formatting (eCTD), KC, CE, FCC, etc. to eliminate global entry barriers for SMEs and achieve sales innovation.
replacements.p1-r6: Establish a critical differentiation by utilizing a proprietary corpus of 1.1 million sentence pairs for business, 600,000 for regulatory certification, and 500,000 exclusive corpora, which cannot be easily replicated in a short term, for domain-specific fine-tuning, thereby creating an overwhelming market entry barrier. [For AI model enhancement] Combine the RAG technology, which injects company-specific knowledge into a hybrid language model based on NLLB/EXAONE, to reduce hallucination phenomena by 70%. Secure simultaneous interpretation performance within seconds delay utilizing InfiniSST and Whisper-based technology. [Commercialization of SaaS Platform] Develop a cloud SaaS web, mobile, API integrated environment that allows end-users to integrate and use their data within 3 days without any IT workforce by leveraging the verified AI platform (Oz-i) infrastructure of the lead organization.
replacements.p2-r0:
[Lead] JPCN Co., Ltd. (Platform/Commercialization oversight): An AI company with 25 years of operation (revenue of 27 billion KRW) possessing the Oz-i AI platform and diverse know-how in R&D projects, ensuring the construction of SaaS platforms, API integration, and the commercialization of cloud infrastructure.
[Cooperation①] StunningBox Co., Ltd. (AI Model/Data): An AI translation data company with 15 years of expertise accumulating specialized datasets, responsible for AI translation fine-tuning, provision of the core asset exclusive corpora, and multi-agent regulatory certification formatting technologies.
[Cooperation②] 3 Demand Companies (Field Proof Validation): Sunlight Illucom Co., Ltd. (auto parts), GenuineGrip Co., Ltd. (specialized footwear), and Gray Whale (K-Beauty) that are award-winning companies, will provide exemplified data by category and quantitatively verify effects through A/B testing.
replacements.p2-r2:
[Economic/Industrial Impact] Enhance export order rates of demand companies by more than 20% and significantly reduce the processing period for regulatory certification documents from the current 4-8 weeks to 1-2 weeks. By the 5th year of commercialization, create revenue of 22 billion KRW (cumulative 68 billion KRW over 5 years), and generate 51 new jobs. Distribute to over 500 SMEs via AI vouchers and KOTRA linkages. Achieve a cumulative export substitution effect of 44 billion KRW over 5 years.
[Securing World-Class Technology] Achieve translation accuracy of BLEU 65+, speech interpretation delay within 2 seconds, and document structure retention rate (TEDS) over 70%, capturing the B2B domain-specific translation market that global big-tech (Google·DeepL) could not solve.

replacements.p4-r89: Export SMEs face complex barriers during overseas business activities, like translation not reflecting company-specific contexts, inappropriate interpretation structure for real-time consultations, and high-cost, lengthy regulatory certification document responses. Hence, a domain-specialized AI platform connecting the entire export business cycle based on corporate data and professional terminology beyond simple translation functions is needed.
